about: Triggering + conversion evals (A9). sync-colors WRITES color schemes in a direction (Figma<->Shopify); read-only intents must route to a validator. conversionCases mirror .claude/scripts/color-utils.js and can be checked against it.

cases.prompt: sync the color schemes from Figma to Shopify
push the Figma variable colors into settings_data.json
copy the Shopify color schemes into the Figma variables
just check whether the colors match, do not change anything
validate the theme JSON before pushing

conversionCases.note: fully-transparent round-trips back to the literal rgba(0,0,0,0)
